body: Benchmarks report what an Artificial Intelligence (AI) agent can do on a task suite, but not whether one released version has been engineered with the controls that make it reliable, safe and observable, or how strongly that is shown. This paper proposes AgentStripes, an evidence-graded maturity model for AI agents. It defines levels (0 to 7 stripes), process areas (12 areas holding 40 capabilities), three gates (basic, safety, proof) that hold an agent at a level however high its score, and evidence grades E0 to E5. Each applicable capability receives a rating from 0 to 3 and a separate evidence level; these are combined into a credit, aggregated into a severity-weighted score and converted into stripes that the gates limit. Instruments gather evidence, language-model judges interpret it under explicit criteria, and the arithmetic is deterministic. The model is compared with standards at topic level without a claim of conformance, and an unexecuted validation protocol is specified. An empirical evaluation (exploratory, non-confirmatory) of 30 public Python agent repositories, with static evidence only, is a demonstration and not a validation: static evidence caps every final stripe at 2, 26 repositories end at one stripe and 4 at two, and this distinction is unreliable, since re-judging changed the final stripe of 4 of 22 repositories (engine, dossier and panel changed), whereas none of 8 panel-only repeats, all at stripe 1, changed. The parameters are expert conventions without outcome based calibration, and the stripes have not been shown to predict reliability or safety.
summaryZh: 当前基准测试仅反映AI智能体在任务集上的表现，却无法评估其是否具备可靠、安全及可观察的工程控制。本文提出了AgentStripes，这是一个针对AI智能体的证据分级成熟度模型。它定义了0到7个等级、12个过程领域及40项能力，设立了基础、安全和证明三道门控，采用确定性算术和语言模型裁判来综合评估。对30个开源智能体库的探索性评估表明，静态证据使所有最终级别受限，凸显了对智能体工程化治理和严格评估协议的迫切需求。

aiReview.reasonZh: 提出了AgentStripes这一首创的AI智能体证据分级成熟度模型，通过多维度门控机制和过程规范填补了智能体工程化可靠性评估的空白。

glossary.explanationZh: 成熟度模型，用于评估组织或系统在特定领域达到结构化、规范化发展水平的框架。
过程领域，成熟度模型中划分的一组相关工程管理或技术实践集合。
证据等级，衡量支撑某项能力评估的数据或文档可信度与严密程度的指标。
门控机制，指必须满足特定硬性安全或证据条件才能晋升到更高成熟度级别的控制点。
